governance: Machine-adjudicated SILVER labels only. The 91 candidates are AUTO_CANDIDATE, not human gold; outputs of this protocol must never be reported as external gold accuracy. No human review gate is included in this pilot.

task.unit: one external grid-domain question + one auto-candidate reference SQL + its database schema context
task.input_to_annotators: question text + candidate SQL + compact schema listing (tables/columns/FKs) + deterministic execution facts (executable, row_count, columns). NO prior labels, NO other annotator output, NO gold_result hashes

annotator_output_schema.required_tables: array of table names from the schema
annotator_output_schema.semantically_correct: boolean: does the SQL fully and exactly answer the question semantics (columns, filters, aggregation, ordering, units/time)
annotator_output_schema.error_classification: none | semantic_mismatch | syntax_risk | unsafe | incomplete_answer | not_answerable | other

sampling.rule: deterministic RNG(seed) stratified by dataset_id proportional to 55:36 (14 RTS_GMLC + 11 SIMBENCH), spread across template_family; sample ids are part of the frozen ledger

adjudicator_C.note: C sees only disagreements; not a generator in the evaluated system

generation_params.response_format: single JSON object, no prose outside JSON

deterministic_checks: candidate SQL executed in read-only SQLite sandbox BEFORE prompting (URI mode=ro, PRAGMA query_only=ON, authorizer rejects writes, 10s timeout, 5000-row output cap)
adjudication_rule: C is invoked only when A and B disagree on answerable_by_schema, semantically_correct, or error_classification, or when either abstains. C sees the question, schema, SQL, execution facts, both labels anonymized as annotator_1/annotator_2, and check results. C outputs a final label with the same schema plus adjudication_note, or ABSTAIN.
stop_conditions: 5 consecutive auth or format failures for one model -> halt and report
served model id differs from frozen id -> halt that annotator and report
ledger_requirements: append-only raw responses; separate parsed labels; record model id, timestamp, prompt_sha256, input/output tokens, latency; never log API keys; sandbox execution facts are part of the ledger
prohibited: calling these labels human gold or external gold accuracy
retrying because a result is disliked
